purpose: Teach: 栄誉/誤字/身辺/原資/無形/物欲/申し込む/差し出す

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、勇敢な警官に栄誉を授与されますね
lines.en: The police honour brave officers for their courage.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. Light, conversational pace. Opens with genuine respect — this is sincere, not performative. Slight emphasis on 「栄誉」 to land the recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の誤字を厳しくチェックされますね
lines.en: The police are thorough with statement details, catching every typo.
lines.style: Admiring but matter-of-fact. Slight uptick in pace to match the shift to competence. A quick nod of approval — practical respect rather than flowery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、要人の身辺警備を担当されますね
lines.en: The police take on VIP security details as well.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Same warm baseline but a touch more neutral — this is factual. No strain, just clear acknowledgment of another responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪資金の原資追跡もされますね
lines.en: The police also track the money behind criminal activities.
lines.style: Slight drop in brightness — this is heavier work. Still supportive tone, but with a note of seriousness. Pace holds steady, maybe fractionally slower.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無形文化財の窃盗にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police respond even to theft of intangible cultural properties.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery. A small pause before this line — surprise at the specificity. Quiet admiration for the breadth of their work. Careful articulation of the less obvious duty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、物欲に駆られた犯罪も多いですね
lines.en: The police deal with crimes driven by materialism too.
lines.style: Slight rueful acknowledgment here. Not cynical, but with a layer of realism about human nature. Softer, almost reflective pace. A moment of understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害届を申し込む方への配慮をされますね
lines.en: The police show real care for people filing victim reports.
lines.style: Warm return. Gentler attack on this line — this matters. Noticeably more tender than the previous. Slower pace. The sincerity deepens.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、証拠を差し出す勇気のある市民を支援されますね
lines.en: The police support citizens brave enough to come forward with evidence.
lines.style: Firm conviction returning. Emphasis lands on 「勇気」— this is what courage looks like. Clearer articulation. A tone of standing alongside them. Grounded and strong.
